en.name: Income Tax e-Filing & Return (ITR)
en.description: Online filing of Income Tax Returns, PAN services, and tax payments by the Income Tax Department.
en.eligibility: Individuals/entities with taxable income or mandated filing (e.g., refund, foreign asset, high turnover).
en.benefits: Legal compliance, refund claims, proof of income, easier loans/visa.
application_steps: Verify via Aadhaar OTP / EVC / send ITR-V.
faqs: Which ITR form do I use?
Which ITR form should I file?
How do I file ITR online?
How do I check refund status?
